title: Roblox Toast Lib Notification
features: Toast is a open source remake of deafult Roblox Toast Notification library with customizable features for example : getgenv().NotifyToast({ title = "Title Here", -- supports HTML content = "Message with colors and bold", icon = "triangle-exclamation", -- BuilderIcons name -- icon = 1234567890, -- rbxassetid number -- icon = "rbxassetid://1234567890", -- rbxassetid string -- icon = "https://i.imgur.com/abc.png", -- URL (auto-download) iconColor = "#FF0000", -- hex string -- iconColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0), -- Color3 iconRadius = 18, -- 0 = square, 18+ / true = circle -- iconRadius = true, -- force circle duration = 5, -- seconds (default 2) callback = function() print("Toast clicked!") -- game:Shutdown() etc. end }) ``` **Quick examples:** -- Simple getgenv().NotifyToast({title = "Hello", content = "World"}) -- Circle icon + color getgenv().NotifyToast({ title = "BAN WAVE", content = "Do not use on public servers", icon = "shield-x", iconColor = "#FF0000", iconRadius = true, duration = 8 }) -- Image URL getgenv().NotifyToast({ title = "Custom Image", content = "From web", icon = "https://i.imgur.com/yourimage.png", iconRadius = 18 }) NotifyToast({ title = "Hello!", content = "This is a toast notification", duration = 3, -- Optional: display time in seconds icon = "rbxassetid://1234567890", -- Optional: icon asset ID or URL callback = function() -- Optional: function to run when clicked print("Toast clicked!") end }) getgenv().NotifyToast({ title = "WARNING!", content = "Custom icon color test", icon = "triangle-exclamation", iconColor = "#FF0000", -- or "#00FF00", Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0) duration = 4 })
